ma.getLocation(Object object)

User authorization: scope.location is required. Obtain the current location and speed. This API cannot be called after the user exits the Mini Program. When the high-precision positioning function is enabled, the API duration increases. You can set highAccuracyExpireTime to specify the timeout duration. High-frequency API calls cause power consumption.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
useFetchData Boolean false No Indicates whether to use prefetch data. (This parameter is added in 23.12.0. For details, see GeographicalLocationPrePull.)
desc String No Purpose information. This parameter will be displayed in the permission popup.（Added in 26.6.0-LG0001）
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object res

Attribute Type Description
latitude Number Latitude. The value ranges from –90 to 90. A negative value indicates the southern hemisphere.
longitude Number Longitude. The value ranges from –180 to 180. A negative value indicates the western hemisphere.
speed Number Speed, in m/s.
accuracy Number Location accuracy.
altitude Number Height, in m.
verticalAccuracy Number Vertical precision, in m. The value 0 is returned for Android because it cannot be obtained.
horizontalAccuracy Number Horizontal precision, in m.
locationEndTime String Positioning end event, the string format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss(This parameter is added in 24.3.0)
locationOrigin String Locate the source of information. If it is pre-fetching, return prefetch, otherwise return location(This parameter is added in 24.3.0)

Sample Code

ma.getLocation({
  success(res) {
    console.log(res);
  }
});

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object res

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String getLocation: ok

object.fail Callback Function

Parameter

Object res

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String error message
errno Integer error code

Error Code List

Error Scenario Error Code Supported by Android Supported by iOS Supported by Simulator Development Suggestion
Invalid request parameter type. 1 Yes Yes Yes
The user rejects the permission to locate the Mini Program for the first time. 701000 Yes Yes Yes Developers are prompted to enable the permission to locate the Mini Program.
The user has rejected the permission to locate the Mini Program. 701001 Yes Yes Yes Developers are prompted to enable the permission to locate the Mini Program.
The user is not authorized or denied the permission to locate the Mini Program. 701002 Yes Yes No Developer-friendly implementation prompts the user to enable the Mini Program location permission. The Mini Program framework throws a pop-up window when the getLocation API is invoked next time.
The system location service is disabled. 701003 Yes Yes No Developer-friendly implementation prompts users to enable the location service permission in system settings.
The location service is disabled in the host app. 701004 Yes Yes No Developer-friendly implementation prompts users to enable the location service permission switch in the host app permission management in system permission management.

FAQs

What should I do if the mobile phone cannot obtain positioning and returns fail after calling the API normally?

A: Go to mobile phone settings-privacy-location services and turn on the switch to access my location information.

Tips

  1. When the Mini Program developer fails to obtain the Mini Program permission(The user rejects the authorization location permission.), the Mini Program developer invokes the openSetting API.

Sample Code

Page({
    data: {
        hasLocation: false,
        location: ''
    },
    getLocation: function() {
        this.requestLocation();
    },
    clearLocation: function() {
        this.setData({
            hasLocation: false,
            location: ''
        });
    },
    requestLocation: function() {
        ma.getLocation({
            success: this.successHandler,
            fail: this.failHandler
        });
    },
    successHandler: function(res) {
        this.setData({
            hasLocation: true,
            location: formatLocation(res.longitude, res.latitude)
        });
    },
    failHandler: function(res) {
        if (res.errno === 701003) {
            this.showModalForSystemPermission();
        } else if (res.errno === 701004) {
            this.showModalForDemoAppPermission();
        } else if (res.errno === 701000 || res.errno === 701001) {
            this.showModalForAppPermission();
        }
    },
    showModalForSystemPermission: function() {
        ma.showModal({
            title: 'Enable the system location permission.',
            content: 'Go to Settings > Privacy > Location Services to enable location permissions.',
        });
    },
    showModalForDemoAppPermission: function() {
        ma.showModal({
            title: 'Enable the location permission of the demo app.',
            content: 'Go to Settings and enable the demo app location permission.',
            success: function(modalRes) {
                if (modalRes.confirm) {
                    ma.gotoBrowser({
                        openUrl: "app-settings:" // This URL scheme supports only iOS. Replace it with that for Android.
                    });
                }
            }
        });
    },
    showModalForAppPermission: function() {
        ma.showModal({
            title: 'Enable Mini Program location permission',
            content: 'Please enable location permissions in Mini Program settings',
            success: function(modalRes) {
                if (modalRes.confirm) {
                    ma.openSetting({
                        success: function(settingRes) {
                            console.log(settingRes.authSetting);
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
        });
    }
})
